name: Code
description: Renders inline code snippets or block-level code samples. Inline mode renders a <code> element; block mode renders a <pre><code> structure. Uses the monospace font family and code typography scale tokens.

block.description: When true, renders as a block-level <pre><code> element with background, padding, and border-radius. When false (default), renders as an inline <code> element.

language.description: Optional language hint for syntax identification (e.g. 'typescript', 'css'). Sets a data-language attribute. Does not perform syntax highlighting.

size.description: Typography scale size. Maps to typography-scale-code-* tokens.

do: Use block mode for multi-line code samples or code examples in documentation
Use inline mode for referencing variable names, function names, or short snippets within prose
Provide the language prop as a hint for tooling or future syntax highlighting integration
doNot: Do not use Code for decorative monospace text — use Text with a mono font if needed
Do not nest block Code inside inline elements
Do not use Code as a replacement for a full syntax highlighter in code-heavy UIs

accessibility.notes: Code elements convey programmatic text semantics to assistive technologies. The <pre> wrapper in block mode preserves whitespace as authored. No additional ARIA is required for basic usage.
